text:
狗岛这边能核实的渠道：Docklands Pharmacy 是 NHS 社区药房，公开写明对 E14 等邮编提供免费处方配送，但非处方止疼药是否配送、有没有货、能不能当天送都没写，建议你先打电话问清这三点。普通止疼药在超市和商店也能直接买到，不过你出不了门，这条暂时用不上。

配送若走不通，可以让能出门的邻居朋友代买，或问药房能否安排送药上门。

sources.title: NHS medicines information
sources.text: Simple painkillers can be bought directly from supermarkets and other stores. This fixture provides general purchasing information, not advice on which medicine is suitable for an individual.

sources.title: Docklands Pharmacy
sources.text: Docklands Pharmacy is an NHS community pharmacy. It advertises free prescription delivery to local postcodes E14 and some others. Contact the pharmacy for details. This fixture does not confirm non-prescription painkiller delivery, stock or same-day service.
